title: ferocactus cylindraceus subsp. eastwoodiae
intro: Ferocactus cylindraceus subsp. eastwoodiae, commonly known as Eastwood's barrel cactus, is a subspecies of the Ferocactus cylindraceus plant, which is a type of cactus native to Mexico. Eastwood's barrel cactus has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, offering potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include wound healing, pain relief, and antiseptic properties, which can aid in the treatment of minor cuts and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of Eastwood's barrel cactus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
